subject.title: fix(signal): add timeouts to container REST requests

question: Should the existing Signal request timeout also define the maximum idle gap between REST response-body chunks?
rationale: The change prevents indefinite pending operations without adding configuration, but it deliberately broadens the behavior of existing short timeout values for paused transfers.

options.title: Accept idle-gap semantics
options.body: Use the existing timeout for header arrival and inter-chunk idle gaps so stalled bodies fail while continuously progressing streams succeed.

options.title: Separate body policy
options.body: Pause the PR and define a distinct body-idle timeout if existing values must retain header-only semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept idle-gap semantics
recommendation.body: Use the existing timeout for header arrival and inter-chunk idle gaps so stalled bodies fail while continuously progressing streams succeed.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the affected Signal container REST client and are the strongest feature-history routing candidate for this contract choice.
